history.summary: A 2027-TOP freehold 3BR in Balestier/Boon Keng (D12), 969 sqft at $2.39M / $2,466 psf, 460m from Boon Keng MRT (NEL), marketed on Hong Wen / St Andrew's school proximity. Freehold and a 5-min MRT walk are real strengths, but $2,466 psf is rich, the 969sqft 3BR is compact, the listing obscures the project name, and there's no project URA data — a fully-priced new launch rather than value.
history.rating_rationale: $2,466 psf is high for a D12 3BR, and at a near-new 2027 freehold the price likely embeds new-launch developer pricing (no project URA series to verify). 969sqft is compact for a 3BR. The spam-style title obscures the actual development, lowering data confidence, and the 278-287 arena record is below-even. Offsetting positives — freehold tenure, 460m to Boon Keng NEL MRT, and school-belt demand — keep it Neutral.
